title: Chapter 110
text:
Someone once said that a glance in the previous life was an ill-fated relationship in this life.

If this sentence was true, Han Xiao felt that he would be an idiot in his next life.

All the enemies that he shot would stare at him with eyes full of anger and hatred before they died.

At the most critical moment, Han Xiao stabilized the situation with his amazing sniping skills, giving the mercenaries a chance to catch their breath. The other surviving snipers also found a more secluded spot and gradually turned the situation around.

You are currently sniping while moving. You have learned some [Moving Sniping] skills. (100/100)

You have learned [Moving Sniping]!

Moving Sniping LVL 1 (0/4500): Reduce shooting accuracy loss while moving, + 2% Critical Hit Rate, + 1% Fire Speed when equipped with sniper type firearms.

Han Xiao saw that [Moving Sniping] did not have much experience to level up, so he immediately threw in the experience points and leveled it up to LVL 4. His control of the sniper rifle was now much smoother.

The attacking enemies were already showing signs of fatigue. They originally wanted to blow a hole in the manor's outer wall with a bomb and then drive into the manor. However, the manor's outer wall was extremely thick with steel plates and concrete, and the maintenance workers were constantly repairing it, so it was impossible to blow a hole in the manor.

Later, when they wanted to break through the manor's defense force, they were once again attacked by Han Xiao. The enemy deeply realized that this attack was not going to work, so they began to retreat, leaving behind wreckage and corpses.

The Y-5 Winged Serpent turned around and flew away. This helicopter did not dare to fly at low altitude in fear of being hit by Han Xiao's bullet and being restrained by Han Xiao. The threat was greatly reduced.

"It's finally over." Han Xiao exhaled. His HP had dropped by about 600 points, and the durability of the magnetic armor had decreased a lot. He was slightly injured, but he had brought spare parts, so he could repair them.

The nearby mercenaries were all exhausted and lying on the ground. Chen Li walked over from afar and looked at Han Xiao in bewilderment. He asked tentatively, "Mr. Black? Are you okay? "

Han Xiao waved his hand, indicating that he was OK.

Chen Li heaved a sigh of relief and was secretly shocked. He never thought that this Scorpion-level assassin would be more reliable than the Poison Bee brothers.

It would not be an exaggeration to say that he had turned the tide by taking on the concentrated fire head-on and sniping the enemy. With such strength, how could he only be at Scorpion-level?

Chen Li reckoned that Mr. Black was a newcomer who had just joined the Dark Net and had yet to be promoted. Based on his performance in this battle, as long as he did not die, he would definitely reach the Ghost Level in the future.

The third round is complete. You have gained 150,000 EXP.

Mission Requirements Changed

Fourth Mission: Repel five waves of attacks.

Reward: 40000 EXP for every wave you repel (You will still gain accumulated EXP even if you fail the mission)

Special Reward: 100,000 EXP

Han Xiao was helpless. Defense mission again? Can't you change it up a little? Three bunkers were blown up, and many mercenaries died. The defense of the manor has decreased. Is this an Endless Mode tower defense mission? The EXP is not bad, and there's even a special reward. So, there's a hidden requirement … What are they up to now?

Han Xiao went to the logistics area to repair his equipment and replenish his ammo. Along the way, he was looked at by the mercenaries. His previous performance had won the respect of these mercenaries and assassins. No one said anything, and they all tacitly allowed him to replace the Poison Bee brothers and lead all the snipers.

Those who were injured were treated, and those who were not went to sleep. The night passed smoothly.

The rain stopped at dawn. The ground was muddy, and the mixture of blood and shrapnel gave off a strange pungent smell.

Han Xiao was taking a nap with his eyes closed when a commotion suddenly came from the walkie-talkie.

"The protection target has appeared!"

Han Xiao immediately opened his eyes and looked at the villa.

The bald old man and the kind-hearted man appeared behind the railings of the villa. All the mercenaries were alarmed and gathered around, curiously looking at the protection target who had finally appeared.

When all the mercenaries and assassins arrived, the bald old man said, "Thank you for your protection these past few days. I want to talk to those whose names are called."

The bald old man read out a list of names. They were all the leaders of the mercenaries and the assassins with outstanding performances. Han Xiao's code name, Mr. Black, was also called out.

"… These people, please come into the villa in ten minutes. I have something to discuss with you."

Mission failure condition changed.

Han Xiao took a look. The restriction that prevented him from entering the villa disappeared.

The appearance of these two people triggered a curious discussion among the mercenaries.

Han Xiao's heart was in turmoil. He recognized one of them.

It's him, Bennett Anderson!

To describe Bennett, there was no need for fancy adjectives. One sentence was enough.

He was one of the main characters of this planet!

Awesome, right? There was something even more awesome.

Bennett was the core character of another main storyline in Blue Star. Only through him could Han Xiao accept the main storyline mission. In other words, this guy would be the thigh that countless players would want to hug in the future.

Furthermore, Bennett … was also a hidden general skills instructor!

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. In just ten minutes, he made a call to the Rothschild Family.

"Alphonso, I hope to exchange for some items …"

"Hmm? Aren't you carrying out a recruitment mission? What do you need? "

"Silver Guardian Hidden Sword, Locke HOC Sniper Rifle."

"… Alright, I didn't expect you to have such a hobby. I'll get someone to collect them for you. I'll send them over in two days."

You have exchanged for [Silver Guardian Hidden Sword] from the Rothschild Family. Favorability decreased by 300. Current relationship: Friendly

You have exchanged for [Locke HOC Sniper Rifle] from the Rothschild Family. Favorability decreased by 200. Current relationship: Friendly

Han Xiao nodded and hung up the phone. Under the gazes of the other mercenaries, he walked into the villa with the people whose names were called.

The interior of the villa was simple and classic. Other than the luxurious chandelier on the ceiling, the rest of the place was not luxurious at all. The bald old man sat on the sofa, and the kind man stood behind him.

"Sit anywhere."

Everyone sat on the sofa and chairs in the hall, but Han Xiao did not sit down. He leaned against the glass wine cabinet in the corner and stared at the kind man. This guy was Bennett. Although he looked like a middle-aged man, he was actually more than sixty years old. The more powerful a Super was, the slower they would age.

The bald old man pushed his black-rimmed glasses and said slowly, "Let me introduce myself. My name is Wang Yuan. I still need you guys to protect me for a while. The reason I called you here today is to meet you guys and inform you that this villa will be open to you. If you want, you can stay here and rest."

"Wang Yuan … never heard of this name." Everyone looked at each other. They were very curious as to why they had been staying in River Valley Manor for so long. Logically speaking, the best choice would have been to seek refuge in Seagull City.

Seeing that Wang Yuan did not take the initiative to explain, they knew that they would not get an answer even if they asked. They only asked about the mission and not the reason because of the nature of their profession.

"You guys are the backbone of the defense of the manor. Once the mission is completed, I will privately give you guys an additional reward," Wang Yuan said calmly.

The eyes of many of the mercenaries lit up. The public reward for the mission would be distributed to the subordinates, but the additional reward that Wang Yuan mentioned would go straight into their pockets.

This meeting was very short. The mercenaries all went back to their subordinates and moved some ammo into the villa. The villa was very big, and there were many empty rooms for some of them to rest.

Very soon, the villa was bustling with activity, and people were coming and going. Wang Yuan and Bennett watched from the side for a while before preparing to leave.

Han Xiao quickly caught up with them.

"Mr. Black, what's the matter?" Wang Yuan smiled. He remembered the outstanding performance of this sniper last night and had a deep impression of him.

Han Xiao looked at Bennett and said, "I want to talk to him alone."

Wang Yuan and Bennett were both surprised. They looked at each other, and Wang Yuan smiled and walked away, leaving the two of them alone.

"Why are you looking for me?" Bennett was confused. "Have we met before?"

Han Xiao took a deep breath and said slowly in a voice that only the two of them could hear.

"Bennett Anderson, a legendary figure who was active during the Old Era War. He was trained in the Mishorodi Training Camp and belonged to the Ordina Intelligence Agency. He was an ace level agent and a cold-blooded killing machine. During the middle of the war, he became the leader of the most elite team in Ordina. His nickname was [Demon Blue]. He carried out hundreds of infiltration, sabotage, assassination, and infiltration operations. Later, he left Ordina and became a traitor. A few decades ago, his bounty was as high as 15 million!

"Then you disappeared for two years. Legend has it that you were traveling in the extreme plains of the Northern Continent, hunting wild beasts in the Koroso Mountains. When you reappeared, you were already one of the strongest humans on this planet. "You started to intervene in the war and didn't help any country. Instead, you helped the civilians who were affected by the war to escape. Gradually, you formed a huge force, which was said to be the predecessor of the Dark Net.

"You appeared in the center of the war again and again. As you saved more and more people, the people of that era started to call you a hero. At the same time, you also created countless shocking achievements. "As the dust of the war settled, you left the world stage and disappeared. You never appeared in the public eye again …"

This long paragraph was the background of Bennett's character given by the officials. Some of the details were forgotten, so Han Xiao only gave a general description.

Every planet had a few protagonist-like characters. They were like meteors streaking across the night sky, leaving behind resplendent traces of that era, leaving behind a thick and colorful stroke in the history of the planet.

Bennett was one of the 'protagonists' of Blue Star. Even Hella at this time couldn't be compared to Bennett. The rise of the Goddess of Death had to wait until later versions.

After listening to Han Xiao's long paragraph, Bennett was shocked. This was the only person in the manor who recognized his identity.

After a few decades, there was still someone who could recognize his appearance. Back then, he was like a block of ice, and now he was like a completely different person. He had changed a lot, so how could he still be recognized?
